t: What Factory Equipment Interoperability Database Is All About
title: What Factory Equipment Interoperability Database Is All About
description: Factory interoperability connects machines: OPC UA (the industrial lingua franca), MTConnect (machine tool data), PROFINET/EtherNet/IP (real-time control), and MQTT for IIoT. Interfaces — mechanical, electrical, data — must all agree. The digital twin needs live data; predictive maintenance needs vibration and temperature streams. Open standards beat walled gardens — specify them. This database is the complete interoperability record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
